title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis led, oil bled, breadth stayed thin.
Intel, Meta and AMD carried a mega-cap tape while 71% of S&P names sit below their 50-DMA; the rally is concentration, financed by SPY outflows of $23.0bn, not broad accumulation. Crude -3.68% is the tell that this is an AI-capex trade, not a demand trade.

INDICES — VIX 14.9, below its 15.7 20-day MA, so no fear bid.
SOXX +4.93%, QQQ +2.77%, SPY +1.55%, DIA +0.76%, IWM +0.52%. Large beat small by 2.25pp. Bonds rallied with TLT +0.68% while the dollar added 0.32%. SPY above its 200-DMA; no CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.2x on +1.55% and QQQ 1.5x on +2.77%: accumulation, but concentrated in the same leadership. IJR printed 0.9x and GLD 0.5x — small caps and gold ignored. Breadth diverges hard: 29% of S&P 500 above the 50-DMA, 49% above the 200-DMA, adv/dec 286/213, up/down volume 2.10, and 10 new 60-day highs against 73 lows. Price is up; participation is not.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLC Comms +3.56%, XLK Tech +2.77%, XLY Discretionary +1.08%, XLV Healthcare +0.37%, XLI Industrials +0.14%, XLRE Real Estate +0.14%, XLF Financials +0.07%, XLB Materials -0.56%, XLP Staples -1.06%, XLU Utilities -1.07%, XLE Energy -2.88%.
IBIT +6.50% and SOXX +4.93% topped industries; XOP -3.07% and USO -3.68% bottomed. Flows confirm the top — XLY +$711mm (100th pctile) and XLC +$133mm — while XLE -$879mm (2nd pctile) and XLF -$697mm bleed. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.82 and QQQ 0.97 are neutral-to-defensive, with SPY skew +4.5% and QQQ +5.9% showing put premium. VIXEQ 38.7 versus VIX 14.9 is a historically wide dispersion gap — a stock-picker's tape, not a correlated macro move. MOVE at 0.0 leaves no bond-vol signal.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -3.68% with energy the sole red sector is a single transmission chain, not a demand scare — 20d oil still +10.04%. Gold -0.70% alongside a +0.32% dollar is textbook dollar pressure, and TLT +0.68% shows duration bid despite equity risk-on. Next FOMC Oct 28, 2026; Polymarket prices 52% for a 25bp hike, +7pp in five days.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 48.5, neutral. INTC +12.14%, META +11.34%, AMD +9.95% were the day's movers; META's 2.6x volume spike on a green close is accumulation. Worst 20d sector is XLB (-7.15%). Watch UNP -3.49% on 2.5x volume — the only high-volume loser — plus XLE, which is being sold regardless of tape, and MAGS at 3.3x volume sitting right on the AI leadership line.
